'''Ceezva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Teltior]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]]. She once bluffed her way into a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with only five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. During the game, she won the [[Unnipar system/Legends|Unnipar system]] from [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Monio]] of the [[Dentamma Nebula/Legends|Dentamma Nebula]].
